description: This file defines the SMP (Serial Management Protocol) transport API for MCUmgr in Zephyr OS, including function pointer types, structures for transport management, and registration functions.

methods.name: smp_transport_init
methods.description: Initializes a Zephyr SMP transport object.

methods.name: smp_rx_remove_invalid
methods.description: Removes queued requests that are no longer valid based on a callback check.

methods.name: smp_rx_clear
methods.description: Clears all pending queued requests for an SMP transport.

methods.name: smp_client_transport_register
methods.description: Registers an SMP transport object for client use.

methods.name: smp_client_transport_get
methods.description: Discovers a registered SMP transport client object by type.
